name: genoffice-trio
description: Suite de office simplificada: sheets, docs, pdf com Vite + React + Electron

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,pdf,shell -c blue,green,red,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/shell"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:shell && concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,pdf,shell,electron -c blue,green,red,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/shell" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron apps/shell"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @genoffice/docs && npm run build -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @genoffice/shell
scripts.test: npm run test -w @genoffice/ui && npm run test -w @genoffice/docs && npm run test -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @genoffice/pdf
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pdf
